name: My Maid Girlfriend: Romance You Choose
source:
You lead an ordinary life until one day, your dad discovers an oil mine that makes you a millionaire. Because of a business trip, your dad has to leave you and hire maids to take care of you.
You find out that your 3 childhood friends got hired to be your maids!
However, your Dad tells you that you can only choose 1 maid when he returns!
When you’re with your 3 lovely maids under one roof…what will happen? Will you find your match “maid” in heaven?
translation:
你原本过着普通生活，直到某天父亲发现一座油矿，让你一跃成为百万富翁。父亲因出差必须离开，于是雇用女仆照顾你。

你发现，自己的三位青梅竹马被雇来当女仆！

然而，父亲告诉你，他回来时你只能选择一名女仆！

当你和三位可爱女仆同住一屋……会发生什么？你能找到命中注定的“女仆”吗？
